hero.title: In the news
hero.body: Our one-line summaries. Read the full stories at the source.

items.kbc-were-justice: Joined leaders calling for the arrest of those behind the killing of Kasipul MP Charles Were.
items.kenyans-land-fraud: Called a Ministry of Lands report on land-fraud cases “shallow and unconvincing” and proposed that the DCI’s land fraud unit take over the investigation.
items.kenyans-rival-in-laws: Profiled among MPs from rival parties who are in-laws; said they would meet over tea and set party differences aside.
